videos.subtitle_summary:

3. HD Hyundai Heavy Industries received a 1.2 point penalty deduction because employees were previously convicted of leaking military secrets related to the KDDX project, which effectively decided the outcome.
4. President Lee Jae-myung (note: this seems to be an error in the transcript as the current president is Yoon Suk-yeol, but the transcript says Lee Jae-myung) previously mentioned this issue at a town hall meeting, creating a favorable atmosphere for Hanwha Ocean.
